note: The file does not say which revision it is for; it was booted in the revision the corpus uses. The payload has bit errors from the read: it starts "SEA\x14EWE\x10" where the game writes "SMA4MWE0", so the game resets its files. GSV type 1 is not a type mGBA knows, so the payload is the rest of the file (64 KiB of the 128 KiB flash).
